uvlo_and_soft_start.document: TI TPS562200, TPS563200, SLVSCB0B (January 2014, revised August 2014), served by LCSC for C49757
uvlo_and_soft_start.shows: The two figures the power-up deck needs and the board had only as prose. UVLO wake-up V_IN is 3.45 / 3.75 / 4.05 V - cpu1.py said 'about 4.1 V', which is outside that band at the top - and the internal soft-start time is 0.7 / 1 / 1.3 ms, where cpu1.py said 'over a millisecond'. Also V_EN(H) = 1.6 V minimum, which matters because this part's EN is hard-tied to the 5 V rail, so it enables as soon as that rail passes 1.6 V and the UVLO is what actually holds it off.
